Subject: Re: Draft MAP and proposed timelines

Maria — thanks for the quick read. Short answers up front, then proposed cadence: 

1) SLA / pilot week: we can set a 99.5% availability SLO for the pilot with reserved Dedicated capacity queued for week 1. That will be codified in the SOW. Day-one reserved capacity requires a signed agreement + PO by July 5 to hit a July 12 start.

2) SA redlines: Lauren, can you confirm the target turnaround on Ben's comments? We expect to accept a small number of commercial edits; anything material (data residency, indemnity) we should flag and escalate.

3) Signature timing: proposed internal timeline —
   - Tue 6/22: Redwood final response to SA redlines
   - Thu 6/24: Customer legal confirmation / sign-off on redlines
   - Mon 6/28: Mutual signature window opens (DocuSign prepared)
   - By 7/5: PO issued from Stellar to Redwood (to secure dedicated capacity)
   - 7/12: Start (pilot go-live)

Attached I’m sharing the execution playbook draft and DocuSign prep checklist. If Stellar needs a later start we can shift the PO date but Dedicated provisioning lead time increases.

Action items: 
- Maria: confirm PO lead time and whether July 5 is achievable for your finance team.
- Lauren: review Ben’s redlines and call out any escalations by EOD 6/17.
- Aditya: prep capacity reservation and a short runbook for pilot-day rollbacks.

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow to walk the gating list.

—Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: SA redlines (high level) — final signoff plan

Maria / team — quick update and final signoff path. 

1) Audit logs: Redwood can commit to 24 months retention by default and include a review checkpoint at month 18 to discuss extended retention for regulated flows. We'll add a contract annex for a 36-month option that requires a scoped work order.

2) Data access for debugging: we will add explicit limited-access, least-privilege language (security ops only, with documented TO/CO controls and customer approval). That will be included in SA v3 response.

3) Liability / pilot carveouts: propose standard pilot liability cap of $100k or fees paid during pilot (whichever is higher). If Stellar needs higher limits we can escalate to commercial director.

Signoff cadence (final): 
- 6/18 EOD: Redwood posts SA v3 with tracked responses (attached: Redwood_SA_v3.docx)
- 6/22: Ben / Stellar legal approve or provide final comment; we will incorporate minor edits same day
- 6/24: DocuSign package ready and sent to primary signers
- 6/28: Targeted signatures complete (documented in HubSpot)
- 7/05: PO receipt confirmed (capacity reservation kicks in)
- 7/12: Pilot starts (canary routing enabled; rollback plan in runbook)

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc-closure-4821
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

If Stellar confirms PO lead time is on track, Redwood will lock Dedicated provisioning and schedule a pre-pilot ops run on 7/9. Maria — please confirm PO timeline and whether your finance/procurement needs any additional artifacts to route the PO.

Regards,
